Helena says to Vanya, "You all abuse my husband and look on me with compassion; you think, 'Poor woman, she is married to an old man.' How well I understand your compassion!" 2% 选择

Helena says to Vanya, "You are cultured and intelligent. [Vanya], and you surely understand that the world is not destroyed by villains and conflagrations, but by hate and malice and all this spiteful tattling. It is your duty to make peace [with Professor Serebrakoff], and not to growl at everything." 正确选项 95% 选择
Helena says to Sonia, "When you come to think of it, Sonia, I am really very, very unhappy." 3% 选择
